resources.string: Thanks for downloading Distance From Me — it means a lot to me. I’m David, and this is my personal project. I really hope you enjoy using it as much as I enjoyed building it, and that it makes your day a little easier.

Hints on the map now show you how to measure, and the app works with an approximate location or none at all. On tablets and wide screens the menu stays beside the map. Distance details work offline, saved distances show their length, and many small fixes make the app more reliable.
This app is available in multiple languages. If you find a mistake or want to suggest a better translation, tap here to email me.
